translationRepairs: A year later he was appointed military governor of Bianfang.
A year later he was appointed military governor of Fufang.
s0049 授鄜坊節度使 names the Fufang circuit; Bianfang misreads 鄜 as if 汴, but the proposed English must not embed the Chinese characters (鄜坊).
Within a year he was appointed military governor of Bianfang.
Within a year he was appointed military governor of Fufang.
s0049 鄜坊 is Fufang, not Bianfang; the literal needs that place-name fix without embedding Chinese characters in the English field.
In the eleventh year of his rule he was killed by his own troops.
In year eleven he was killed by his own troops.

s0073 十一年 is a calendar/regnal year eleven, not the eleventh year of Quanhao's personal rule; the proposal rightly drops that error, but this unit does not name the Xiantong era, so the parenthetical invents information.
In Taihe 2 (828) the Cangjing military governor Li Quanlue died. His son Tongjie seized the garrison city, petitioned for the commissioner's credentials, and Xiancheng raised an army against him.

In Taihe 2 (828) the Cangjing military governor Li Quanlue died. His son Tongjie seized the garrison city, petitioned for the commissioner's credentials, and an army was raised to campaign against him.
s0026 ends 舉兵伐之 with no named subject; inventing Xiancheng as attacker contradicts the next unit (s0027), where he secretly supplies Tongjie, so the agentless passive is the correct fix.
Before long the court sent Secretariat Director Wei Wenke as imperial envoy to offer reassurance.
Before long the court sent Director of the Bureau of Gates Wei Wenke as imperial envoy to offer reassurance.
s0017 司門郎中 is Director of the Bureau of Gates, not Secretariat Director; the proposed office title matches the Chinese.
Soon the court dispatched Secretariat Director Wei Wenke to proclaim consolation.
Soon the court dispatched Director of the Bureau of Gates Wei Wenke to proclaim consolation.
The literal likewise mistranslates 司門郎中 as Secretariat Director; Director of the Bureau of Gates is the correct office.
On the night of the thirteenth day of the seventh month of Tianyou 2, yamen guard deputy Li Gongxian mutinied, and Wei barely escaped with his life.
On the night of the thirteenth day of the seventh month of Tianyou 2, yamen guard deputy Li Gongquan mutinied, and Wei barely escaped with his life.
s0175 李公佺 has 佺 (quán); Gongxian is a wrong reading of the given name, and Gongquan restores it.
On the night of the thirteenth day of the seventh month of Tianyou year two, yamen guard army deputy commander Li Gongxian made disorder; Wei barely escaped with his person.
On the night of the thirteenth day of the seventh month of Tianyou year two, yamen guard army deputy commander Li Gongquan made disorder; Wei barely escaped with his person.
Literal repeats Gongxian for 李公佺; Gongquan matches 佺.
s0176 公佺 is the short form of 李公佺; Gongquan, not Gongxian, is required.
Literal short form must likewise follow 公佺 as Gongquan.
Quanzhong's daughter had been married to Wei's son Tinggui, who had recently died.
Quanzhong's daughter had been married to Wei's son Tinggui; she had earlier died.
In s0179 全忠女妻威子廷規，先是卒 the subject of 先是卒 is Quanzhong's daughter; s0180 助女葬事 confirms her funeral, so death cannot be attributed to Tinggui.
